items.summary: rmagine: build a per-header include gate for the 16 installed rmagine_cuda headers. tests/cuda/public_headers.cpp gates only the together-in-one-TU property; per-header independence is not covered, and two headers (math/linalg.cuh, util/cuda/CudaHelper.hpp) fail as the first include of a TU on both the CUDA and the ROCm include paths -- pre-existing upstream defects. The deferred work is that per-header TU gate plus the two two-line upstream fixes (<stdexcept> in CudaHelper.hpp, a runtime include in linalg.cuh), i.e. edits to upstream headers this port otherwise leaves untouched. NOT part of this item, and already done in fork commit 1213551: rewording the test's opening comment so its claim matches what the test proves.

rmagine builds its default GPU context in a namespace-scope global (src/rmagine_cuda/src/util/cuda/CudaContext.cpp:198), so any executable linking rmagine::cuda aborts while loading the library on a machine with no device, before main. That makes a runtime device-count skip in a dependent's test unreachable (measured for rmcl's GPU test); a lazy context would let dependents report a skip instead of a hard test failure.
